Great to hear that you are interested in losing weight and adopting a healthy lifestyle. Here is a weekly meal plan that can help you achieve your goals:

Monday:
- Breakfast: 2 scrambled eggs, 1 slice of wholegrain toast, 1 small orange
- Snack: 1 small apple, 10-12 almonds
- Lunch: Grilled chicken salad with mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and a balsamic vinaigrette dressing
- Snack: Greek yogurt with berries
- Dinner: Baked salmon with steamed veggies

Tuesday:
- Breakfast: Greek yogurt with banana and a handful of granola
- Snack: 1 small pear, 10-12 cashews
- Lunch: Turkey and cheese sandwich with wholegrain bread and veggies on the side
- Snack: Carrots sticks with hummus
- Dinner: Grilled chicken with roasted veggies

Wednesday:
- Breakfast: 1 cup oatmeal with milk, honey, and mixed berries
- Snack: 1 small orange, 10-12 pistachios
- Lunch: Tuna salad with mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and a lemon vinaigrette dressing
- Snack: Apple slices with almond butter
- Dinner: Stir-fry with chicken, broccoli, carrots, and brown rice

Thursday:
- Breakfast: 2 boiled eggs, 1 slice of wholegrain toast, 1 small orange
- Snack: 1 small apple, 10-12 almonds
- Lunch: Grilled tofu and vegetable kebabs with hummus
- Snack: Greek yogurt with berries
- Dinner: Baked chicken breast with roasted sweet potato and green beans

Friday:
- Breakfast: Greek yogurt with banana and a handful of granola
- Snack: 1 small pear, 10-12 cashews
- Lunch: Veggie wrap with hummus, avocado, spinach, cucumber, and tomato
- Snack: Carrots sticks with hummus
- Dinner: Grilled fish with steamed veggies

Saturday:
- Breakfast: 1 cup oatmeal with milk, honey, and mixed berries
- Snack: 1 small orange, 10-12 pistachios
- Lunch: Chicken salad with mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and a balsamic vinaigrette dressing
- Snack: Apple slices with almond butter
- Dinner: Pan-seared shrimp with quinoa and roasted veggies

Sunday:
- Breakfast: 2 scrambled eggs, 1 slice of wholegrain toast, 1 small orange
- Snack: 1 small apple, 10-12 almonds
- Lunch: Asian salad with mixed greens, edamame, crispy noodles, and a sesame dressing
- Snack: Greek yogurt with berries
- Dinner: Grilled chicken breast with roasted sweet potato and green beans

In terms of your workout plan, here is an effective 4-day per week plan that you can use to target belly fat and tone your entire body:

Day 1: Cardio and Abs
- Warm up with 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Jog in place for 5 minutes
- 30 seconds of high knees followed by 60 seconds of rest
- 30 seconds of jumping lunges followed by 60 seconds of rest
- 30 seconds of burpees followed by 60 seconds of rest
- 30 seconds of mountain climbers followed by 60 seconds of rest
- Repeat this circuit 4 times
- Do 3 sets of 20 crunches, 20 Russian twists, and 1-minute plank

Day 2: Lower Body
- Warm up with 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- 30 squats followed by 30 seconds of rest
- 30 jump squats followed by 30 seconds of rest
- 30 lunges followed by 30 seconds of rest
- 30 jump lunges followed by 30 seconds of rest
- Repeat this circuit 3 times
- Do 3 sets of 20 leg raises, 20 donkey kicks, and 20 fire hydrants on each side

Day 3: Upper Body
- Warm up with 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- 30 push-ups followed by 30 seconds of rest
- 30 dips followed by 30 seconds of rest
- 30 tricep extensions followed by 30 seconds of rest
- 30 bicep curls followed by 30 seconds of rest
- Repeat this circuit 3 times
- Do 3 sets of 20 shoulder presses, 20 lateral raises, and 20 front raises

Day 4: Yoga and Stretching
- Warm up with 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Do a 30-minute yoga routine to stretch and release any tight muscles in your body
- Finish with 10 minutes of stretching and deep-breathing exercises

Remember to always stay hydrated during your workouts and listen to your body. If you need to rest, take a break! Also, make sure to consult with a healthcare professional before starting any new exercise or diet plan. Good luck on your weight loss journey!
